title: [DASH] Feature request: Force screen ON while activating/deactivating pod
body:
When activating a pod phone screen turns black a few times during the process. It would save some hassle if there could be added an option (or possible force it without option) to keep the screen always on while in certain tabs in Dash plugin, mostly needed while activating pod. 

Similar feature to the option to keep screen always on in Overview tab in AAPS and what is done in the medtrum driver.

comments.body: I have the code that adds this ready in AS, just need to manage to make my first pull request. Probably tomorrow :)
